Home loan interest rates

Compare our variable and fixed rates below.

Variable rates for owner occupiers

The Basic Home Loan has a variable rate of 6.04% p.a. and a comparison rate of 6.07% p.a. for borrowers with a loan to value ratio of 60% or less. For a loan to value ratio between 60.01% and 80% the variable rate is 6.14% p.a. and the comparison rate is 6.17% p.a.

Fixed rates for owner occupiers

The two year fixed rate is 5.79% p.a. with a comparison rate of 6.44% p.a. The three year fixed rate is 5.99% p.a. with a comparison rate of 6.49% p.a. Fixed rates can be locked for ninety days for a fee of $395.

Things you should know

All applications are subject to the lender's normal credit approval criteria. Fees and charges apply. Full terms and conditions are set out in the loan offer.
